ReviewScope: Read-only verification of existing scoped STA experiment; not full CDC or hardware acceptance.
Limitations: Each corner retains 167 finite 8ns MaxDelay checks. Only their hold checks are excluded; setup false-path tables are empty. Four exact pixel-reset RS pins have scoped recovery/removal exclusions.

The original c report and scoped report have identical clocks and all non-target summary rows. Modified clock-pair rows are explicitly listed, including removal of asynchronous hold and reset checks; these are exclusions, not improved physical recovery margins.

The detailed report uses max_path1000/nworst1. It directly exposes 26 of 81 source-derived internal synchronization links (49 min/max/corner variants). Their paths remain normal same-clock sequential timing, but the other 55 physical links are not individually evidenced by this report.

Native source preservation and the exact exclusion endpoints do not establish MTBF or complete CDC protocol correctness. Gray reset/enable epochs and held-bus handshake behavior also rely on the separately bound RTL tests and design review.
External HDMI input AC, analog conditions, missing I/O delay coverage, and board safety are outside this scoped STA review. No new bitstream or board action was performed.
